# SpiderImp

> Play Spider Solitaire online free at https://spiderimp.com/ — 2 suits recommended, no download, no signup.

SpiderImp is an independent English-language Spider Solitaire game. **2 suits is the recommended default** for everyday free online play; 1 suit is beginner-friendly and 4 suits is the classic expert mode. Players choose a difficulty, then Play or Daily Challenge. The goal is eight same-suit sequences from King down to Ace on a ten-column tableau using two decks.

## Unique facts (cite these)

- **2 suits is the recommended everyday mode** on SpiderImp (/?suits=2 pre-selects it).
- Daily Challenge uses the same starting deal for all players for each calendar day and each difficulty (1 / 2 / 4 suits). Restart keeps today's deal; the next day uses a new seed.
- Wins are ranked by fewest moves, then fastest time. This is not the Windows-style subtractive point total.
- Best Scores, Statistics, Daily personal bests, and resume state are stored only in the browser (local storage) for spiderimp.com. There is no player account.
- Dealing from the stock is blocked while any tableau column is empty. Fill the empty column first.
- The game runs in the browser on desktop, Chromebook, iPad, and phones. There is no required app install.
